title: Geekvape Wenax K1 SE Replacement Pods - 3 Pack
description: With a fixed 1.0ohm coil, these pods provide a super-satisfying and flavoursome MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape experience when paired with the GeekVape Wenax K1 SE pod kit. These 2ml pods are best used with Nic Salts , 50/50 and classic High-PG E-Liquids. The Geekvape Wenax K1 SE pod kit adds to GeekVape’s Wenax range of super-compact and simple to use pod kits. These replacement pods can contain 2ml of your favourite e-liquid and are simple to refill thanks to the handy side-fill port. Compatible With High PG, Nic Salt and 50/50 E-Liquids.
